---
name: Proposal
about: Propose a change to the ARV spec, schemas or examples
title: "Proposal: "
labels: proposal
---

## Problem

What can you not do today with ARV? Who hits this (publisher, platform, player, agent builder)?

## Proposal

What should change? Name the spec section, schema fields and example files.

## Example

A JSON example or a short request and response that shows the change.

## Compatibility

Does a valid 1.0 document stay valid? What does an implementer that ignores the change see?

## Implementations

Who would implement this, and is anyone ready to build it? A feature becomes required only after two independent implementations pass the validator.
